Lemma
[The horizontal lift depends smoothly on the data]

↗ def:horizontal-lift-linear

Let $N$ be a smooth manifold, and let $x\mapsto B_x$ and $x\mapsto A_x\in \operatorname {Hom}(E,E')$ be smooth families of bilinear forms on $E$ and linear maps. If $B_{x_0}$ is positive definite and $A_{x_0}$ surjective, then the corresponding lifts $L_x$ are smooth at $x_0$.

Proof

↗ def:horizontal-lift-linear ↗ lem:horizontal-lift-linear-spec \sketch Use $L_x=B_x^{-1}A_x^t(A_xB_x^{-1}A_x^t)^{-1}$. Transpose and composition are smooth, and inversion is smooth at the invertible operators supplied by Lemma 7.

□
